div.div: 2 شنّر عَلَيْهِ , inf. n. تَشْنِيرٌ, He blamed him; found fault with him; attributed or imputed to him, or accused him of, a vice, or fault: (K:) or the same, (K,) or شنّر بِهِ, (O,) or شنّرهُ, (TA,) he rendered him infamous; exposed his vices, faults, or evil qualities or actions; disgraced him; or put him to shame. (O, K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
